D=/tmp/morph/parse-command; mkdir -p $D; S=$(date +%s)-$$; L=$D/acc-$S.log
cp src/cli/parse.ts $D/0-$S.ts 2>/dev/null
cp tests/cli/parse.test.ts $D/1-$S.ts 2>/dev/null
(
 set -e
 node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
 node_modules/.bin/eslint src/cli/parse.ts tests/cli/parse.test.ts
 node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/cli/parse.test.ts --reporter=dot
 node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=dot
) > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; cat $L; exit $rc
